profile.headline: Software Engineer Lead at CACI
profile.summary: I have been successfully developing information system applications from concept to operations for 20 years.  I would like leverage those skills to a position where I can lead others to successfully develop and maintain systems for an organization.  I also would like to help organization's make the best technology and resource choices to be successful in their mission and goals.

positions.title: Software Engineer Lead
positions.description: Develop .NET internet applications from vision to deployment.

positions.title: Sr Software Developer
positions.description: Worked with a small team of architects to develop/design a framework that was used as a basis for a suite of applications developed for a government client.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: As the first hire of the director of the retirement practice, I designed and implemented a plan that successfully moved the organization systems from a distributed architecture to a centralized architecture.  These systems were available 24x7x365.   I also helped build a team of developers and a DBA that developed and maintained software that supported the retirement practice.  I also designed and implemented a hot disaster recovery plan in the event we needed to relocate data center operations.  This plan was successfully put to the test on 9/11 and worked flawlessly.  After everything was in place I developed and maintained software for the practice.

positions.title: Advanced System Engineer
positions.description: Lead a small team of visual basic developers to produce client server applications for government clients.

certifications.name: ITIL Foundation Certificate in IT Service Management
certifications.title: ITIL Foundation Certificate in IT Service Management

volunteerExperiences.description: I served as one of two Vice Presidents for the Wheaton High School PTSA.  My role was to organize, plan, and raise funds for the many activities the PTSA sponsor at Wheaton High School.  Our largest event is Post Prom where I raised almost $15,000.00, which exceeded our goal by 20%.  We provide mini-grants throughout the year for deserving educational projects.  We support the teachers and staff every year with Teacher Appreciation breakfast.  Finally, we provided critical communication to our membership on school funding and other relevant information that impact the quality of life of our students.

I served on the board of the Wheaton High School PTSA in the function of webmaster and managed the list serve.  These communication mediums provide the community up to date information on events and needs of the high school which facilitates community involvement and support. I also set up and managed mobile and online payment systems to improve fundraising and membership initiatives.
